fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects installation of new certificate on the system which attackers may use to avoid warnings when connecting to controlled web servers or C2s
fields.name: Install Root Certificate
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/update-ca-certificates" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/update-ca-trust"))
